requirements.text: Risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained
Risk management shall be a continuous iterative process throughout the entire lifecycle
Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices
Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, representative, free of errors and complete
Data sets shall take into account the characteristics or elements particular to the specific geographical, behavioural or functional setting
Technical documentation shall be drawn up before the AI system is placed on the market and kept up-to-date
High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed with capabilities enabling automatic recording of events (logs)
High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way to ensure transparency and enable users to interpret output
High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons
High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact with natural persons are designed to inform them that they are interacting with an AI system
General-purpose AI models shall meet requirements for technical documentation, information to downstream providers, and cooperation with authorities
General-purpose AI models with systemic risk shall comply with additional obligations including model evaluation, adversarial testing, and incident monitoring
